title: Big Sur road trip from LA
hook: Highway 1 is open again. Some stops aren't.
dates: 3 days, any winter weekend (checked for December 2026)
who: Families with kids about 4 and up; one car, two nights

stops.name: Leave Los Angeles
stops.why: North on US-101: about 340 mi today, so start early

stops.name: Solvang Restaurant
stops.why: Home of Arne's aebleskiver, the Danish treat
stops.kid_note: Powdered sugar and jam: messy, worth it.

stops.name: Check in: Portola Hotel & Spa
stops.why: Downtown Monterey, by Old Fisherman's Wharf

stops.name: Old Fisherman's Grotto
stops.why: The wharf restaurant known for its clam chowder
stops.kid_note: Strict stroller, high-chair and children's policy (since 2009): read it before you go.

stops.name: Monterey Bay Aquarium
stops.why: Watch the sea otter feeding (10:30 AM on our check)
stops.kid_note: Free for ages 4 and under, but they still need a ticket.
stops.booking_note: Buy ahead on the aquarium's own site; tickets were on sale through Dec 31, 2026. Hours vary by date.

stops.name: Carmel Belle
stops.why: Lunch made with local Monterey County produce
stops.address: Ocean Ave & San Carlos St, Carmel-by-the-Sea, CA 93921

stops.name: Bixby Creek Bridge
stops.why: See it from the car: no parking near it since August
stops.booking_note: 12-month ban on parking from about 900 ft north to 700 ft south of the bridge.

stops.name: Pfeiffer Big Sur State Park
stops.why: Redwood Grove Boardwalk and River Path are open
stops.kid_note: The Pfeiffer Falls trail is closed until further notice.
stops.booking_note: $10 per car; 8 AM to sunset. Reopened Oct 16 after the Timber Fire closure.

stops.name: Ragged Point
stops.why: Cliff-top stop 350 ft above the Pacific, Big Sur's south gate

stops.name: Cambria Christmas Market (select dates)
stops.why: 3 million lights, Santa, a train ride, fire pits
stops.kid_note: Santa visits and a train ride for the kids.
stops.booking_note: Nov 27 to Dec 31 on select dates, 5 to 9 PM. Tickets required; peak dates sell out. Night 2: Cavalier Oceanfront Resort, about 6 mi north.

legs.note: About 15 mi on Highway 1. One-way traffic control at Rocky Creek Bridge through Nov 30.
About 13 mi. One-way control near Point Sur through Dec 31.
About 49 mi of the curviest stretch.

stops.name: Piedras Blancas elephant seals
stops.why: Free, open daily; big males arrive from late November
stops.kid_note: No restrooms at the viewing area, so stop before.
stops.address: Highway 1 north of San Simeon, CA
stops.booking_note: Flat shoes and a jacket: afternoons turn cold and windy.

stops.name: Hearst Castle, Grand Rooms Tour
stops.why: A 70-minute tour; a bus takes you up the hill
stops.kid_note: About 140 steps and a 2/3-mile walk; the ride down passes the old zoo's bear pits.
stops.address: 750 Hearst Castle Rd, San Simeon, CA 93452
stops.booking_note: Book up to 60 days ahead; arrive 20 min early. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Day.

stops.name: Giovanni's Fish Market & Galley
stops.why: Fish and chips on the bay; family-run since 1985

stays.name: Portola Hotel & Spa
stays.why: Downtown Monterey by Old Fisherman's Wharf; pet-friendly.

stays.name: Cavalier Oceanfront Resort
stays.why: San Simeon's only oceanfront resort, 3 mi from Hearst Castle: two heated pools, oceanfront fire pits.

stays.name: Ragged Point Inn
stays.why: Ocean-view rooms 350 ft above the Pacific at the south end of Big Sur.
stays.night: Night 2, if you skip the market

heads_ups.text: Old info says Highway 1 is closed at Big Sur. It reopened at Regent's Slide on Jan 14, 2026; on Nov 10 Caltrans showed it open end to end, with one-way control at Rocky Creek Bridge (through Nov 30) and near Point Sur (through Dec 31).
No stopping for the classic Bixby Bridge photo: since August, Monterey County bans parking on Highway 1 from about 900 ft north to 700 ft south of the bridge, for 12 months.
The McWay Falls Overlook Trail is closed for a retaining wall project, and there's no beach access at McWay Falls.
Pfeiffer Big Sur reopened Oct 16 after the Timber Fire closure, but the Pfeiffer Falls trail stays closed; the Redwood Grove Boardwalk and River Path are open.
Hearst Castle is closed on Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Day; tours book up to 60 days ahead.
